Proof sketch: derive `LocallyOfFiniteType (L.schemeNsmul n)` from `schemeNsmul_over` and `locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp`. Lift `z.1` through `schemeNsmul n` to `x`. Get `x ≫ f = t` from `schemeNsmul_over`. Use `nsmul_natural` on `idPoint` and `Category.comp_id` to identify `L.nsmul t n ⟨x, _⟩` with `z`. This is exactly lines 237–257 of the current proof with `O.L`, `O.g` and `resPt A ≫ Λ.σA` generalised.
